item.title: How to Handle Trouble
item.description:
Series: Splendor in the Furnace: 1 Peter, Part 1 | Scripture: 1 Peter 1:6–9 | Preached: September 26, 1993

Dr. Timothy Keller explains how Christians navigate suffering using 1 Peter. Sufferings and glory are bound together, echoing Jesus Christ's journey. Biblical doctrine provides necessary joy during trials. Believers experience both grief and inexpressible joy, as suffering serves a purposeful, God-monitored role in shaping spiritual wholeness and deep self-discovery.
